notes.title: The Demo Is Out !!!
notes.content:
[h3][/h3][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45277168/85bad66e2f443a859e870cca1b3dfa6f71073ba5.jpg"][/img]

Hello, [b]explorers![/b] I hope everyone is doing great! [/h3][h3]Today we are finally launching the first public early version of the game!
  [/h3][h3]Are you ready to [b]play[/b] [b][u]The Last Worlds : Crossed Souls[/u][/b] ?

[b][u]The demo version 0.1.1 is finally live on Steam[/u][/b] and the planet Ness-444 is waiting to be explored! 

Please keep in mind this is our first [b][i]public early version[/i][/b] of the game and that this is only the beginning of The Last Worlds , also in the upcoming months we will add tons of content and new stuff to the game , [b]totally for free![/b][/h3][h3]
We would love to receive all of the possible [b][i]feedback[/i][/b] from you guys and if you encounter any bug , please consider joining our [url="https://discord.gg/ZEc6mH38T3"]Discord Server [/url]

We want to shape this game with the help of [b][i][u]everyone[/u][/i][/b] , every single idea and opinion you have matters , having you sharing your ideas/improvement will be crucial for The Last Worlds!
[/h3][h3]Just a reminder: our [b][u]Kickstarter campaign launches on October 1, 2025[/u][/b] where you can partecipate directly in the game development by creating missions , armor and weapons , enemies and much more , also you can get [i][b]time-limited rewards[/b][/i] , you can wishlist for the campaign so that you will not miss it :


- [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/lupiostudios/the-last-worlds-crossed-souls-open-world-3d-action-rpg-0" buttoncolor="#58fb37"]Kickstarter Campaign Link [/url]- 

[url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/lupiostudios/the-last-worlds-crossed-souls-open-world-3d-action-rpg-0" style="button"]Click Here For The Kickstarter Page[/url]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45277168/bf430cca53f8eb845a2e11f88577816bdf93e18c.jpg"][/img][/h3][p][b]Thank you[/b] for your attention! We can't wait to see you playing [b]The Last Worlds![/b] [/p]

notes.title: Early Access Demo Release Date
notes.content:
[h3][/h3][previewyoutube="YFbJDMeLGgI;full"][/previewyoutube][h3]

Hello, [b]explorers![/b] How's everyone doing? 
[/h3][p]This is our [b]first Steam Update[/b], and we're here with [i][b]exciting news![/b][/i]
 [/p][h3]The big news is that you can finally [b]play[/b] The Last Worlds : Crossed Souls ! 
Mark your calendars for [u][b]September 16, 2025[/b][/u], the release date for the [u][b]first playable DEMO.[/b][/u] 
[/h3][p]We’ve put in a lot of effort to create the best game with our current resources. 
The Lupio Studios TEAM has grown to [i][b]seven members[/b][/i], and we plan to expand to at least ten in the future! 
[/p][p]We look forward to hearing about your [i][b]experiences[/b][/i] with our game. 
Your support has made this possible, and we value your [i][b]feedback[/b][/i] to help us improve!
